# SalonKit

> Salon and barber shop management software made in Dubai for salons in the UAE, by AFFWORLD FZ-LLC. Front-desk billing with 5% VAT tax invoices, staff commission, the daily sheet, WhatsApp bills and reminders, and Google review requests, in AED, in any web browser.

## Key facts

- Plans (AED): Free, AED 0 (up to 2 staff); Pro, AED 200 per month (up to 10 staff); Pro Max, AED 499 per month (unlimited staff, WhatsApp, ledger, audit log).
- Every new salon gets 7 days of Pro Max free, no card needed.
- UAE ready: amounts in AED, 5% VAT, tax invoices with the salon's TRN, Dubai time, +971 numbers.
- Runs in the browser on phones, tablets and computers; each salon gets its own address (yoursalon.salonkit.online).
- Languages: English and Arabic.
- Company: AFFWORLD FZ-LLC, 2704 Prime Tower, Burj Khalifa Street, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE. Support: support@salonkit.online.
